title: AppDefinition
description: Root schema for a Swarm Cloud Marketplace application definition (v1alpha1).

secrets.description: Publisher secrets required by this application. Values are entered by the publishing organization at publication time and referenced via {{ secrets.<name> }} in deployment values.

slots.description: Named data slots that marketplace datasets can be bound into at configure time.

outputs.description: Values exposed to the user after deployment.

evidence.description: What the publisher guarantees a deployment of this version will attest to.

name.description: Unique application identifier. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

version.description: User-facing application version (SemVer). Independent of component chart versions.

category.description: Single catalog category from the marketplace taxonomy (e.g. ai-inference, data-storage, web-apps).

sourceRepo.description: URL of the application's source repository. Input for audits and AI review.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the application's source code (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0).

icon.description: Relative path to the icon file.

description.description: Optional helper text below the heading.

fields.description: Ordered list of fields in this section.

widget.description: Widget type override. Defaults based on parameter type: `multiselect` for an array parameter. `hostname` also says what the field is: the address the deployment answers on, which a marketplace holding a DNS zone can fill in on the operator's behalf instead of asking them to prove control of a domain by hand.

value.description: Value template. Supports {{ params.<id> }}, {{ components.<name>.release }}, and {{ namespace }} interpolation.

when.description: Expression controlling whether this output is shown.

expectedDigest.description: Canonical deployment-evidence snapshot digest every deployment of this version must produce, as bare lowercase SHA-256 hex. Obtained from a reference deployment; the platform cannot derive it from the charts because the cluster defaults fields the templates never write.

exclude.description: Fields that legitimately differ between deployments of this version and are therefore omitted from the snapshot, making expectedDigest a property of the version rather than of one deployment. Equivalent to the swarm.io/exclude-evidence-fields annotation, for definitions whose charts cannot be annotated. The resulting exclusion set is itself digested, so it cannot be widened after publication without changing the digest.

kind.description: Kubernetes kind this entry applies to, e.g. Ingress.

name.description: metadata.name this entry applies to, after release-name substitution.

match.description: Narrows the entry to some documents. Omit to apply it to every document the deployment sends.

fields.description: JSON Pointers to omit. Identity pointers (/kind, /apiVersion, /metadata, /metadata/name) may not be excluded — a resource that cannot be identified cannot be attested.
